_comment: Reader fonts. Add a font by dropping its file in files/ and its licence in licences/, then adding an entry here; no code changes. Paths are relative to assets/fonts/. The first entry is the default. lineHeightRatio is the font's own ascent + descent, so box-drawing verticals join.
